quarterly_data.signal: On the ABB joint venture for its power distribution and control equipment business (low-voltage circuit breakers, electromagnetic switches, measurement and control equipment, UPS of 5kVA or less for general industry), the Japanese notice states that the consolidated forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027, announced July 31, 2026, does not include the impact of the transactions, and that the company expects that impact to be minor.
